sourceRows.zh: n. 目录 目录册 大学概况手册 商品型录 vt. 做目录 分类说明 名入列表 vi. 研究(手册或目录) (商品)在型录中明码标价

ex.en: Furthermore, science has many safeguards in place to catch instances of bias that affect research outcomes.
Like a lot of spots in New Zealand, there are whale-watching trips and you might just catch sight of sharks.

col: catch someone's attention｜吸引某人的注意
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为caught；感冒用catch a cold。

sourceRows.zh: n.捕捉 陷阱 捕获物 接(球等) 扣栓物 隐患 vt. 捉住 赶上领会 了解 感染 被钩住 击中 察觉 vi. 抓住 燃着

senses.zh: n.总教堂 大教堂

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the cathedral's beautiful stained glass windows.
ex.zh: 阳光透过大教堂美丽的彩色玻璃窗洒了进来。

ex.en: Restoring a historic cathedral can preserve traditional craftsmanship while attracting visitors who support the local economy.
ex.zh: 修复历史悠久的大教堂既能保护传统工艺，也能吸引游客，支持当地经济。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。

sourceRows.zh: n.总教堂 大教堂

senses.zh: n.牛 牲口 家畜 畜牲(复数)

ex.en: However, raising cattle, pigs, and other land-based animals requires vast sums of grain and water.

tip: cattle是复数集合名词，用are；单头牛不用a cattle。

sourceRows.zh: n.牛 牲口 家畜 畜牲(复数)

senses.zh: n.原因 理由 事业 vt.引起 使发生

ex.en: Another cause is that the proportion of people who are trying to lose weight has been increasing over time.
The exact cause of these phantom traffic jams has long remained a mystery.

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

sourceRows.zh: n.原因 理由 事业 vt.引起 使发生

senses.zh: n.山洞 洞穴 窑洞 vt.挖空 塌落 屈服 vi.塌落

ex.en: Of the oldest cave paintings discovered, some are up to 40,000 years old and there are more images of animals than humans.
I bet our ancestors returned home from hunting wild animals and gathering nuts, and complained about how little time they had to paint battle scenes on their cave walls.

tip: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

sourceRows.zh: n.山洞 洞穴 窑洞 vt.挖空 塌落 屈服 vi.塌落

senses.zh: vi. &vi. &n.停止 终了 停息

ex.en: Despite alarmist headlines about "foods that are going extinct," there is no evidence that major food types like beans, chocolate, wine, corn or wheat will cease to exist.
At times, these breaks and transitions will be self-determined, at others they will be forced as existing roles, firms, or industries cease to exist.

tip: 较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。

sourceRows.zh: vi. &vi. &n.停止 终了 停息

senses.zh: n.天花板 顶蓬 上限

ex.en: Additionally, a painted ceiling is a magical thing without being too obvious and can affect how the space feels as well.
I estimate you have between 210 and 240 square meters of walls and ceiling.

col: set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

sourceRows.zh: n.天花板 顶蓬 上限

senses.zh: vt.庆祝 歌颂 赞美 vi.庆祝 祝贺 颂扬

ex.en: Elementary school classrooms celebrate cultural holidays—Lunar New Year!
I bought a new suit for work and took my parents to a nice restaurant to celebrate.

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

sourceRows.zh: vt.庆祝 歌颂 赞美 vi.庆祝 祝贺 颂扬

ex.en: The most common types of financial support include cell phone plans, food, school costs and car expenses.
The 2011 report mentioned "smart cell phone" and "new screen" technologies, but did not address interactive apps.

tip: 生物语境常指细胞；prison cell指牢房。

sourceRows.zh: n.细胞 小房间 电池 小组 单人牢房 (蜂房的)巢室 手机

ex.en: The builder mixed cement and water in a bucket.
ex.zh: 建筑工人在桶里搅拌水泥和水。

senses.zh: n.分 分币 百(分之)

ex.en: "Forty-four per cent would buy another drink, which is not great, 14% would go without and 4.5% said they would find a fountain," she says.
However, this number was 31 per cent when in the presence of ae unknown student from another university.

col: not a cent｜一分钱也没有
a fifty-cent coin｜一枚五十分硬币
tip: cent是可数名词；金额超过一分通常用cents。

sourceRows.zh: n.分 分币 百(分之)
